surface: training data ingestion and data-quality audit
targeted_mechanism: eight source schemas and partial labels can create false negatives or train/eval leakage when blindly concatenated
expected_behavioral_effect: all corpora become auditable, partial labels remain masked, and exact holdout overlaps are excluded from training before fitting
regression_risk: text extraction failures or an overly broad coarse-label mapping could discard useful rows or add noisy positives
decision: keep: the fixed audit exposed material leakage and preserved partial-label masks without touching evaluation gold
